designs.rationale:
Same design: the Ledger metrics line (record, money, ROI, recorded time, source badge, chips) on the left as the profile tap target, and a perforated bet-slip stub on the right as the bet-sheet tap target, with a side filter strip, a six-slot count grid, and a collapsed "Show all 9" list. Revisions, all measured with wc -c: total is now 15,767 bytes (7,968 html + 7,799 css), under the 16,384 cap. What came out: the four :has() empty-state rules, the .v8-empty style and its

(unreachable with this fixture since every side has at least one capper, and Safari below 15.4 ignored them anyway), and the nine stub aria-labels that restated the visible pick and price. Link aria-labels stay because they add the "NFL profile" destination. Layout fixes: the ident line now has about 217px of room on rows 1 to 6 (was ~204) by trimming the stub to min 84 / max 100px with 6px right margin, the disc to 30px, the link padding to 10/4 and the gap to 7px; the source badge dropped to 9.5px with 4px side padding, so "OldSchool0909 + chevron + Action Network" (~204px) and "KnightDasCapital + Polymarket" (~191px) stay on one line and those rows hold the 56 to 72px target. On rows 7 to 9 the stub caps at 100px (main column ~201px) and "no price, graded at -110" wraps inside the stub at the comma ("no price," / "graded at -110", ~77px at 10px inside a 79px inner width), while the sub line gap tightened to 6px and the chip padding to 2px 5px so "Recorded 21h before start" plus the L5 chip (~187px) sits inside the column without a third sub-line. Stub notch dots moved to left 3px to match the narrower left padding; they still sit at top/bottom -5px inside the 6px stub margin, so the list's overflow:hidden never clips them. Count line note for the orchestrator: the mandated copy says "3 sources" but the fixture's nine rows carry four platform badges (Action Network, Polymarket, Community, Covers); the copy is left verbatim as required and the mismatch is a fixture/copy question, not a fragment defect.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free users see the same fragment: names, discs, source badges, picks with lines, prices, counts, the recorded time and the humility, unqualified and grading lines are all visible. The Ledger metrics line (record, money, ROI) and the streak / small-sample chips are the natural paid layer: on free, render .v8-met and the chips as a muted "Record on paid" placeholder inside the same slot so row heights and the two tap targets do not move. The slip stub stays tappable on free, with the bet sheet's "Track this side" button and the record-on-this-bet-type row behind the same gate.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the counts freeze ("freezes at kickoff" is already in the count line). Once graded, each stub gains a small W / L / P mark next to the price ("at -108, W") using the existing .v8-w / .v8-l chip tints and the muted border for pushes; the metrics line updates to the post-game NFL record so both surfaces agree, and the hint line reads "Final. Tap a name for the NFL profile. Tap a slip for that bet." The side filter strip and slot counts stay as they were at kickoff, since counts are counts.

issues: SIZE: html (8,482 bytes) + css (8,571 bytes) = 17,053 bytes, over the 16 KB cap (16,384). Measured with wc -c. Roughly 700 bytes must come out: the four :has() empty-state rules (~900 bytes) are dead weight for this fixture since every side has at least one capper, and the aria-labels on the stubs restate visible text.

COUNT LINE vs DATA: the required copy says '3 sources' but the rows show four platform badges (Action Network, Polymarket, Community, Covers). The copy is mandated verbatim so it stays, but the mismatch is visible on the page; note for the orchestrator, not a fragment defect.
layout_risks: Ident line wraps on rows 1, 4 and 5: main column is ~204px wide (360 list inner, minus 98px stub+margins, minus 58px padding/disc/gap); 'OldSchool0909' + chevron + 'Action Network' badge is ~206px and 'KnightDasCapital' + 'Polymarket' is ~201px, so the badge drops to its own line. Not truncation (flex-wrap handles it) but those rows grow to ~90px, above the 56 to 72px target.

Rows 7 to 9 (the 'no price, graded at -110' stubs) push the stub to its 112px max-width, shrinking the main column to ~180px; 'Recorded 21h before start' + the 'L5' chip is ~178px, so the chip sits at the edge and may wrap to a third sub-line on some font renderings. Still no clipping.
Empty-state rules depend on :has(); harmless here (unreachable with this fixture) but Safari below 15.4 ignores them.
Stub notch pseudo-elements sit at top:-5px / bottom:-5px inside a 6px stub margin, so they stay within the row box and are not clipped by the list's overflow:hidden. Verified by geometry, not render.
critique.design_notes: Checks (a) through (j): (a) every selector starts with '.v8' (root rule is '.v8 {' itself, all others '.v8 .v8-*'), @media block scoped, no <style>/<script> in html. (b) only token vars plus rgba tints of --accent (59,130,246) and --green (34,197,94) and 'transparent' in the gradient. (c) no em dashes (grep 0); grep on forbidden words hit only 'top' as the CSS property top:-5px and 'to bottom' in the gradient, never copy. (d) all nine cappers present in DOM with name, badge, record, money, ROI, pick, price, recorded time; Small sample only on HomeRunHazard; W5 chip with flame on OldSchool0909, L5 with snowflake on stevet81, nothing else. Collapsed to five via '.v8-f-all:checked ~ .v8-x:not(:checked) ~ .v8-list .v8-row:nth-child(n+6)' with 'Show all 9' rendered visible under the All tab (hidden under side filters, where at most 3 rows show). (e) all five required strings verbatim. (f) money order 212, 188, 96, 61, 41, 34, -86, -118, -140 correct. (g) no text-overflow anywhere; nowrap only on tabs (~68px each, 'Under 1' fits), slot cells (~113px, 'Under 44.5' fits), the source badge (inside a flex-wrap ident row) and chips; names use overflow-wrap:anywhere with no width cap; stub max-width 112 leaves 89px inner and .v8-spr is display:block with normal wrapping, so 'no price, graded at -110' wraps to two lines rather than clipping. (h) collapsed height ~770px at 362px (head 58, strip 38, slots 61, hint 21, list ~400 incl. three 90px rows, more 45, note 46, unq 23, grade 73); expanded ~1,090 but a collapse control is present, within bounds. (i) two distinct targets per row: name/disc link with chevron and hover, stub with ticket notches + perforation + accent hover ring; hint line spells out both; aria-labels distinguish 'NFL profile' from 'open bet sheet'. (j) segmented tabs and slot grid carry plain counts, no meter, no rank labels, both sides styled identically. Single failing item is the byte budget; trim the dead :has() empty-state rules and it passes.

designs.rationale: Same two-line ticket design, two things hardened. (1) The "by NFL money" sort label moved out of the filter row and up to the header, on the title's baseline at the right (title is about 180px wide, so about 170px of slack at 362px). The filter row is now five pills alone (about 262px with the padding trimmed to 10px), so no system font can push anything onto a second line. (2) The ticket notches no longer overhang the card. Each row paints its own half-discs as radial-gradient backgrounds anchored to its border-box corners (bg fill plus a 1px border ring), so the notch is drawn entirely inside the row and needs no outer overflow clipping; the list's overflow:hidden is now only for its rounded corners. First row draws only bottom halves, last row only top halves, so the card's rounded ends stay clean. Every other rule (metrics order, two tap targets with dotted-underline name and chevron slip, side filter radios, empty state, required copy) is unchanged.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free users see the same list structure. Name plus source badge and the pick with its line stay visible; the price chip, the NFL record / money / ROI cluster and the recorded-time line render as blurred placeholders with one "Unlock capper records" line under the list. Both tap targets remain but route to the upgrade sheet.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line reads "9 cappers, 3 sources, frozen at kickoff". Once graded, each slip gets a small W / L / Push chip after the price chip (green for W, red for L, muted for Push) and the recorded line is replaced by the graded result at the recorded line, e.g. "Graded W at CHI +1.5 (-108)". The side filter and both tap targets keep working; Track this side is hidden on the bet sheet for a started game.

layout_risks: Filter row is close to full width at 362px (five pills + 'by NFL money' measured on one line at 36px); a wider system font could push the sort label to a second line, adding about 22px. Wrap is graceful, not a clip.
Ticket notch pseudo-elements (::before/::after at -7px) rely on .v9-list overflow:hidden to clip; harmless, but any future removal of that overflow rule would show 6px discs outside the card edge.
critique.design_notes: Rendered the fragment at exactly 362px content width (390px viewport) with the host tokens and measured with getBoundingClientRect. Results: total 875px; head 54, filter 36, list 620 (six rows at 68px, three 'no price' rows at 73px), hint 45, note 33, unqualified 16, grading note 41. Document scrollWidth 390, no horizontal overflow. (a) Every CSS selector, including the @media block, starts with '.v9 '; html has no style/script. (b) Colors are the tokens plus rgba tints of accent, green, and muted only. (c) No em dashes; none of the banned words appear in copy or labels ('top' occurs only as a CSS property). (d) All nine cappers present with name, source badge, record, money, ROI, pick, price chip, recorded time; Small sample on HomeRunHazard only; W5 flame on OldSchool0909 and L5 snowflake on stevet81 only. (e) All five required strings verbatim. (f) Order is +212, +188, +96, +61, +41, +34, -86, -118, -140. (g) No text-overflow ellipsis anywhere; names use overflow-wrap anywhere with no nowrap or fixed width, so KnightDasCapital sits on one line at 14px with room to spare (name line 17px, no wrap). Nowrap is used on .v9-pick, .v9-price, .v9-nums, .v9-when, but these are inside a flex-wrap container with no overflow hidden on the row, and measured widths fit with margin (metrics column ~150px, price chip two lines via the explicit br at phone width, 32px tall). The only elements whose scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth are the rows and list (367/360) caused by the decorative notch pseudo-elements, which is the intended clip. (h) 875px, under the 900 target, no collapse control needed. (i) Two tap targets per row: name+disc anchor with a dotted underline and hover accent color (profile), and the full slip anchor with hover surface, active tint, and a chevron (bet sheet); the hint paragraph explains both. (j) Counts only via filter pills and per-row lists, no meter, no rank numbers, both sides styled identically. Note for the author: the harness screenshot showed mojibake on the emoji chips because my test page lacked a charset meta; the fragment itself is fine when the host page declares UTF-8.

designs.rationale: Same direction as before: a five-row collapsed ledger with the money leader opened as a torn ticket, side/total filter strip, per-slot counts, Show all 9. Fixes in this pass, nothing else touched. (1) The expanded slip's grid now holds only fixture-backed cells: "Their line CHI +1.5 at -108" and "NFL picks 68" (41+27). The invented "Line now" cell and the placeholder "NFL spreads" cell are gone, which also removes the only em dash in the copy. (2) The expanded row's bet-sheet target (.v10-big) is now a dashed-edge ticket with a "Bet sheet" caption in accent and an accent chevron, so it reads as tappable exactly like the collapsed rows' dashed-edge slip cells. (3) The header chevron is now a real control: a 28px round label bound to a checked-by-default checkbox (#v10-o). Unchecking collapses the slip (tear + body hidden, chevron flips to point down) and the row falls back to the standard collapsed shape, with the same compact "CHI +1.5 / at -108" slip cell and chevron as every other row, so nothing is lost when it closes. To make that fallback possible, the leader's metrics line, recorded time and W5 chip moved into the header (same markup every other row uses), so the expanded and collapsed states share one ident block. Layout notes: the slip cell max-width went from 118px to 130px for Dynamic Type headroom; hover rules, letter-spacing and default-bold restatements were trimmed to keep html+css under 16KB (16,351 bytes measured). No text-overflow anywhere; long names wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free viewers see the same section. The bet sheet and Track this side link into the existing tracking flow, which gates on sign-in as today; no numbers here are paid-only. Nothing in the fragment reveals scoring or source mechanics beyond the platform badge already shown on capper profiles.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line copy would switch from "freezes at kickoff" to a frozen-at-kickoff phrasing, the "Recorded Nh before start" lines stay as-is, and each slip cell would carry the graded result in place of the "Track this side" button (the button and bet-sheet target are hidden once the game is live). The ticket header toggle keeps working in the graded state so the leader's slip can still be closed.

issues: Invented content in the expanded slip: the 'Line now' cell shows 'CHI +1.5 (-110)', which is not in the fixture (the fixture has no current line). 'NFL spreads' shows a placeholder '—' with no fixture value behind it. Rule: use real content from the fixture only, invent nothing beyond it. 'NFL picks 68' is derivable (41+27) and is acceptable.
Em dash present in copy: the 'NFL spreads' cell renders '—'. Rule says no em dashes anywhere in copy. Either drop the cell or show a plain word such as 'not recorded'.

Expanded row's bet-sheet tap target (.v10-big, the large 'CHI +1.5' + 'at -108') carries no visible affordance (no chevron, ticket edge, or underline), so a reader cannot tell it opens the bet sheet. The collapsed rows do mark both targets (dotted name underline + dashed ticket edge with chevron), but the one expanded row does not.
The .v10-up chevron in the expanded header reads as a collapse control but is decorative only (no label/for target), so the open slip can never be collapsed. Misleading affordance.
layout_risks: .v10-bet has max-width:118px with a nowrap .v10-pchip. At default type the widest chip ('Under 44.5', 12.5px bold, about 82px incl. padding) totals roughly 110px, so it fits with about 7px of slack. Any larger text setting (iOS Dynamic Type) would push the chip into the chevron and then be clipped by .v10-list overflow:hidden. Marginal at 362px, not a failure at default size.

Expanding the first row to a full slip (about 280px tall) is editorial emphasis on the top-money capper; not a rank label, but it gives one side (CHI) visibly more real estate than the others in the collapsed state.
'Brian Bitler' + 'Action Network' badge is within a few px of the 188px ident width; the badge will likely wrap under the name. Wrapping is allowed, just noting the row grows to about 82px.
html + css together are close to the 16KB cap (estimated 14 to 15KB); any additions should be checked.
critique.design_notes: Scoping is correct (every selector starts with .v10, no style/script). Colors stay inside the token set (rgba tints of accent/green/red only). All nine cappers are present with name, source badge, record, money, ROI, pick, price, and recorded time; Small sample chip only on HomeRunHazard, streak chips only on OldSchool0909 (W5 flame) and stevet81 (L5 snowflake). Sort by money is correct. Five required copy strings are verbatim. Collapsed state shows five rows plus a visible 'Show all 9' label; the checkbox/radio selector chain is valid in DOM order and the filter hide rules out-specify the .v10-open display rule. No text-overflow: ellipsis anywhere; names use overflow-wrap:anywhere with enough width (about 188px) that KnightDasCapital (about 120px) wraps the badge rather than the name. Height at 362px collapsed: head 56, strip 38, slot grid 56, list (expanded slip about 279 + 4 rows at about 66 + show-all 37 + border) about 592 incl. margin, humility 29, unqualified 23, grading note about 73, total roughly 870px. Fails only on the invented current-line value, the em dash placeholder, and the missing affordance on the expanded slip's bet link; those are cheap fixes.

designs.rationale: Same side-grouped ledger, four fixes. (1) The group header no longer carries a price. It was stitched together from individual cappers' recorded prices and read as a current market line that the section does not have; it now shows only the side, the markets present in that group (ML, spread, total) and the capper count, and the legend states outright that prices are each capper's recorded price, not a current line. (2) Sort stays money-descending within each side group; the group order DAL / CHI / Over / Under is fixed by side, not by money, which is the premise of this variant and is noted here as a deliberate deviation from a single global money sort. (3) Row height: padding 5 to 4px, row gap 3 to 2px, chip line-heights 17/15 to 16/14, so a row with a wrapped sub line lands at about 70px and an unwrapped row at about 54px, inside the 56 to 72 guide give or take a pixel. (4) overflow: hidden removed from the group card; the header gets a matching top radius and the last row a bottom radius, so nothing can ever clip silently. The short market label in the header cannot wrap under the side label at 362px.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free users see the same grouped ledger: names, discs, source badges, picks, prices and the counts. The NFL record, money and ROI cluster on each row is blurred (filter: blur on .v11-met) with the card's upgrade prompt below the last group. The bet sheet still opens from the pick chip and ticket but its "Track this side" button routes to the paywall.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line changes to "9 cappers, 3 sources, frozen at kickoff" and the ticket affordance on each row is replaced by a result chip (W green, L red, P muted) once the game grades; the group headers keep the side and count only. Rows keep their pregame order; nothing re-sorts on result.

issues: Caution (non-blocking): the group header lines ('DAL ML -125 / DAL -1.5 (-110)', 'CHI +1.5 (-110) / CHI ML +105', etc.) are composed from individual cappers' recorded prices and presented as if they were the side's market line. The fixture supplies no game line, so this reads as a current line that does not exist in the data (VeryLucky888 is at -118 while the header says -125). Either drop the price from the header or label it as 'as recorded'.

Sort is money-descending WITHIN each side group, not globally (side grouping is this variant's premise). Global order across groups is DAL / CHI / Over / Under regardless of money. Acceptable for a side-grouped ledger but note it deviates from a strict single money sort.
layout_risks: Rows with a wrapped sub line render at 74px, slightly above the 56 to 72px guide (5 of 9 rows: Mattcanter, OldSchool0909, HomeRunHazard, stevet81, thirdstring).
.v11-group has overflow: hidden (for the 12px radius). Safe today because every child wraps, but any future nowrap addition inside a row would clip silently rather than overflow visibly.
Group header .v11-gline wraps under the side label if the browser font is wider than SF; only cosmetic.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) every selector begins with .v11 (root .v11 plus .v11 descendants, the @media block only re-targets .v11 .v11-met); html has no style or script tags. (b) Colors: only the eleven tokens plus rgba tints derived from accent (59,130,246), green (34,197,94), muted (136,146,164); gold unused. (c) No em dashes; none of the forbidden words appear in copy or aria-labels; no score/points/band/percentile/rank labels. (d) All nine cappers present with name, source badge, record, money (green/red), ROI with the word ROI, pick chip, price chip, recorded time; Small sample only on HomeRunHazard (9-6); streak chips only OldSchool0909 (W5 flame) and stevet81 (L5 snowflake); Community badge on RiverCityRick. (e) All five required strings verbatim. (g) No text-overflow anywhere; the nowrap spans (.v11-roi, .v11-when, .v11-src, .v11-pchip, .v11-price, .v11-chip) sit inside flex-wrap containers so they wrap as units; .v11-met max-width 160px wraps rather than clips (measured 120 to 147px); .v11-name has overflow-wrap: anywhere and a minmax(0,1fr) column, and all nine names measured single-line including KnightDasCapital, HomeRunHazard, RiverCityRick; 'no price, graded at -110' and 'Under 44.5' render whole. Live render: no element with scrollWidth over clientWidth. (h) Measured 903px total at 362px (macOS SF font), under the 950 flag line, no collapse control needed. (i) Two distinct targets per row: name and disc link (dotted underline, aria-label 'NFL profile') and the pick chip plus a 26x44px ticket icon on the right (aria-label 'Bet sheet'); legend line spells both out. (j) Sides are same-styled groups with a plain count, no meter, no ranking labels, both teams and both totals sides equal.

designs.rationale: Same two-layer design: a horizontal rail of bet slips (pick, price, name, NFL money) for the at-a-glance read, then the full ledger below with the exact metrics line, source badge, recorded time and chips. Revisions only: (1) root selectors now read `.v12 {` and `.v12 * {` so every selector literally carries the ".v12 " prefix; (2) the filter tabs drop overflow:hidden and nowrap in favor of flex-wrap, so a label can never clip, it drops its count to a second line if the strip gets narrower than ~300px; (3) the rail gains three scroll cues without JS: a right-edge gradient fade over the scroller (derived from --bg), a "Swipe for all 9 slips" chip with a chevron leading the hint line, and scroll-snap so slips settle cleanly; the rail also carries right padding so the last slip clears the fade when scrolled to the end. Slips widen from /3.2 to /2.8 of the row (about 125px at 362px, ~109px inner), giving KnightDasCapital room on wider fallback fonts so overflow-wrap only fires as a last resort. The ledger bet cell grows from 106px to 114px so "Under 44.5" sits in the chip with ~13px spare instead of ~5px. Two tap targets per row are unchanged: dotted-underlined name + disc opens the NFL profile; the dashed ticket edge + chevron on the right opens the bet sheet. Cappers stay sorted by NFL money descending. Collapsed to five rows with "Show all 9" so the game page's other sections stay one thumb-scroll away.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free viewers see the section title, the count line, the rail and ledger with names, source badges, picks and prices, the humility line, the unqualified line and the Grading Note. The metrics line (record, money, ROI), streak chips and the bet sheet's "Track this side" button are paid; on free the metrics span renders a muted "Record on paid" placeholder of the same height so rows do not reflow, and the slip's money line is omitted. Filter tabs and Show all 9 work on both tiers.
designs.graded_state_notes: Once the game is final the count line swaps "freezes at kickoff" for "frozen at kickoff", each slip and ledger row gains a small W / L / Push chip next to the pick chip (green border for W, red for L, plain for push) using the same chip component, and the rail sorts graded results first. The name, metrics line, recorded time and price stay exactly as captured; nothing about the capper's NFL record on the row updates until the nightly ratings pass, and the Grading Note stays as the last line.

issues: Nit: the root selector is written `.v12{` (no trailing space) rather than `.v12 {`. It is still fully scoped to the fragment, so not a leak, but it does not literally match the ".v12 " prefix rule.

`.v12 .v12-tab` uses overflow:hidden + white-space:nowrap. At 362px each tab gets ~64px of content and the longest label ("Under 1", ~44px) fits, so nothing clips, but this is the one place the flagged clip pattern appears. It is on filter labels, not on names/picks/prices.

The horizontal slip rail duplicates every pick that the ledger already shows; only ~3.2 slips are visible at 362px and the other six sit off-screen behind a hidden-scrollbar scroller. Not a rule break (the page itself does not overflow), but a reader has no visual cue that the rail scrolls beyond the partial fourth slip.
layout_risks: Rail slip inner width is ~95px at 362px (calc((100%-12px)/3.2) minus 12px padding and 2px border). "KnightDasCapital" at 10.5px/600 measures ~84px in SF Pro, so it fits, but with overflow-wrap:anywhere a slightly wider fallback font (Roboto/Segoe) could break the name mid-word onto a second line. Wraps rather than clips, but a mid-word break on a name is ugly; widening slips to /2.8 or dropping max-width pressure would add margin.

Ledger bet cell is a fixed flex-basis of 106px with 16px right padding (chevron lane) and 6px left, leaving ~84px; the pick chip inner width is ~70px. "Under 44.5" at 12px/700 measures ~65px, so it fits with ~5px to spare. If it ever does not fit the chip wraps ("Under" / "44.5"), never clips, but it is tight.

The two-line price ("no price,
graded at -110") relies on a hard
at phone width and the @container rule hides the
at 560px+. Fine in both states; just noting the price cell height varies by row (56 to 68px), always shorter than the left link so row height is set by the profile side.
Tab strip: 5 tabs at ~68px each with nowrap + overflow:hidden. Fits at 362px; would begin clipping only below ~300px content width.
Rail is overflow-x:auto with scrollbar hidden; intentional, but it is the only element that can move horizontally and there is no fade/edge cue.
truncation_risks: No text-overflow:ellipsis anywhere. No overflow:hidden+nowrap on any capper name, pick, price, metrics line, or recorded time. Names (.v12-name, .v12-sn) use overflow-wrap:anywhere so they wrap, never clip. Badges (.v12-src) and the recorded-time span (.v12-when) are nowrap but sit inside flex-wrap containers, so they drop to a new line instead of clipping. The only nowrap+hidden element is the filter tab label, which fits with ~20px spare.
critique.design_notes: Height at 362px, collapsed (default state): header ~56, slip rail ~109 (tallest slip ~101 with a two-line price), hint ~25, filter strip ~38, ledger 5 visible rows at ~71-75 each inside a bordered list ~377, Show all 9 control ~45, humility line (2 lines) ~46, unqualified line ~30, grading note (3 lines at 11px) ~73. Total ~800px, comfortably under the 950 ceiling, with the visible \"Show all 9\" label rendered by default (.v12-f-all:checked ~ .v12-more {display:flex}). Expanded adds ~290px (~1090) which is fine since a collapse control exists. Rules audit: all selectors scoped under .v12 (root nit noted); colors are only the tokens plus rgba tints of accent (59,130,246), green (34,197,94) and muted (136,146,164); no em dashes; no forbidden words (\"profile\" is not \"pro\"); all nine cappers present with name, source badge, record, money (green/red), ROI with the word ROI, \"Recorded Nh before start\", pick chip, price chip; Small sample only on HomeRunHazard; streak chips only on OldSchool0909 (W5 flame) and stevet81 (L5 snowflake); rows sorted +212, +188, +96, +61, +41, +34, -86, -118, -140; five required strings verbatim. Two distinct tap targets per row: profile link (disc + dotted-underlined name, aria-labelled \"NFL profile\") and the bet cell (dashed ticket-edge left border, chevron, right-aligned pick chip), plus the slip rail as a third bet-sheet entry; the hint line spells both out. Counts are plain numbers on equal-weight tabs, no meter, no rank labels. Filter CSS (radio + sibling selectors) works with the DOM order given: hid rows stay hidden only under All and reappear under a side filter, and the Show-all control hides under side filters.
